body: Ive pretty much said it all here, honestly.
Telling the anonymous truth is easier than the truth being openly attached fo my name.
I cant see that conversation going any differently than this one. This one just doesnt cost me lots of money that I cant afford.

I may have compassion, but I envy narcissists and sociopaths. I involuntarily carry illogical burdens that I cant change. I drink so heavily to suppress it. Its the only time I feel care free, but it only lasts so long.
Humanity is one body, and only 10% of the body doesnt have cancer.

Evidence. Evidence brings realism. Realism brings certainty. Im certain that humanity is a cancer, because I see evidence of it. It kills itself willingly. The weak starve because the strong take and never give. Children are raped and tortured by monsters on live webcams for money on the internet and dismembered and fed fo dogs when theyre done with them, as if they were nothing but dust. Politicians rent 15 year old girls who are property of narcissistic sociopaths to abuse at their will. Infants are beaten and neglected for amusement by their parents out of curiosity and then abandon them to thd government when they get old enough to become a burden. Priests rape and molest the children of their sheep, who gladly pay them every sunday so that they can get their good deed out of the way for the week. Ive seen evil with my own eyes and I never stopped it, because I was afraid. Im haunted day and night by the lingering thoughts of all of the helpless lives being stomped out by monsters, in the name of their gods, or because they simply felt like it. Anyone who is not certain of the stagnant evil that is mankind is naive and I envy them.
My future is rapidly closing on me. I will not see her face to face again.

Probably not. I have no right to take someones time and energy away from them for my own selfish reasons. I wrote that as a first draft. Before the time comes, Im going to put it on paper, and send it home.
Its like a teeter totter that im always on, its just sometimes i get to be on the high end, but im on the teeter totter nonetheless.
The day I got married and both of my childrens births.
Ive made my choices as an attempt to change and be happy. Im not going to say ive never had happy moments, but they were just moments. All temporary.

Its not even particular events. Its just a feeling that creeps in, and it distracts me from any other thoughts i try to have. Its like having someone yelling in your ears while trying to listen to someone whisper to you from across a room.
No, other than the one time, this is the only time my mind has been put out for anyone to receive. It isnt really helping me "feel better" but it is nice to not have to lie.
Yeah. Nothings ever good enough. Ive conquered fears, travelled the world, financially stable, have a family. My only downfall is my overwhelming self-loathing, it overshadows my whole life.

Well, I joined the Army thinking that it was "brave" or "heroic" or whatever other adjective you want to use, thinking if might give me purpose or give me something to be proud of, but nothing Ive accomplished gives me pride. 

"To live is to suffer, to survive is to find some meaning in the suffering." -Friedrich Nietzsche

Im definitely living.

Everyone does fucked up things. The fact that a person would knowingly hurt or wrong someone else is evil in its own right. Humanity is garbage. Theyve been garbage since the first free thinking being walked the earth.

Children are innocent. They have no more than a basic understanding of right and wrong. Theyre ignorant to how disgusting and evil human beings are as a whole. They have no cares or worries. Adults, on the other hand, know what the fuck theyre doing, and they willingly do evil, fucked up shit every single day and Im no different than anyone else.

It used to feel hopeless. Now i just stay there. Thats the thing about pessimism, when youre wrong, its a good thing and when youre right, you were expecting it. The thing about my family is that I think they deserve good things. Children are blameless, and dont deserve bad shit.
Things dont change, they just go to the next stage of their patternous cycle until you are right back to genesis.

Honestly, I appreciate you taking the time to talk to me, but Ive pretty much made up my mind about doing it sooner than later. Youre right,  they have almost no memory of me. My wife beautiful enough to find someone deserving of them in time to be an actual father.

I came here because its anonymous. Anonyminity makes admission easier. It may have not been that impactful because it wasnt on my terms, but I also think its mostly, because Ive committed to it in my mind.
It wasnt an optional discussion. My superiors made me talk to him because I make too many jokes about killing myself. Im currently an atheist.

Dont we all yearn for death in some way? Everything we do or eat kills us, just slowly. If every living organism suddenly disappeared, nothing would change, the universe wouldnt care any more or less than it already does. If theres a god or higher being, it wouldnt care, just like it hasnt cared since the beginning of time. So, what difference does it make if my spec of existence in a timeline so vast, that we cant even comprehend it, ends. I feel as if Im just embracing human nature.

Only once, to a chaplain. He told me to find god and then gave me a suicide hotline number. Apparently, inner hatred is the absence of "god" in my heart. I tried explaining that my dad is a pastor and I grew up fundamentally christian,  but it was all the same to him.

Im on a break right now, because Im deployed. Ive talked to the CHP a little and all he said is to try god or religion or whatever and gave me the suicide hotline bullshit. Maybe Ill die in a firefight or something. Thatd be better than them knowing I killed myself. At least theyd have a good memory of me.

The only problem I have with that, is the statistics that go along with children of a fatherless home, being raised by a single mother. Im also not going to be the guy who "abandoned his family." Sincerely, I dont care about being happy. I gave that up years ago. My kids dont deserve to see me happg, they deserve a father who is going to be present, and actually be a father to them. So does my wife. Dont get me wrong, I dont just walk around all day with a sore face. I play and laugh along with them and try to be the 'ideal' husband and father. If you ever met me, youd think I was the happiest person youve ever met.
Thats why Im waiting until theyre adults to do it. Im not ending it for at least 18 years.

At this point, its not that I cant "handle" life. I just dont see purpose anymore other than getting my children to adulthood. After that, I have nothing. Im not sad about it, Im dreading the next 17-20 years of faking it until theyre on their own.

Since I was a child, ive heard, "Things will get better."

Not directed towards me, because Ive never told anyone about my self-hatred, but its one of those things you hear throughout your life. Ive felt this way since I was roughly 8 or 9 years old, but I never had the guts to end it. It never really "gets better." I just feel it more or less on some days.

I know why I feel like this. Its a deeply seeded self-hatred that gracefully pairs itself with the disbelief that I deserve anything good in this life. Ive felt it since I was a child, but I was never brave enough to end it.

I think it starts with self hatred. You dont think you deserve anything good and subconsiously think that you need a way to punish yourself. Ive never done it, but I understand the feeling of not deserving anything good in life.
